name: tt-debug-tools
description: Drive the Tenstorrent debug tools and read their output: tt-triage, dprint, watcher, asserts, etc.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the Tenstorrent debug tools and read their output: tt-triage, dprint, watcher, asserts, etc.
interface.longDescription: One skill per debugging question. Each teaches how to put the stack in the state a tool reports on, how to run it, and how to read what comes back. Needs a Tenstorrent device and a built tt-metal checkout.
defaultPrompt: My Tenstorrent job is hung — get me the device state.
